summary: Ghosted partial output and missing terminal metadata for SSE client after connection multiplexing handoff behind corporate proxy
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that for long-running SSE streams initiated from the hosted API, the client sees the correct prefix tokens but never receives the terminal 'end' event and final metadata. This happens after a connection handoff event on the customer's corporate edge (multiplexed connection reuse between multiple HTTP/2 clients). The stream shows a ghosted partial: final tokens appear in the server logs and in the worker process, but the SSE session never emits the close/end marker and the client's JS SDK stays waiting.

Impact:
- Two enterprise customers (same corp network) experience incomplete responses for multi-paragraph outputs 3-5% of the time on long streams (>12s).
- Customer-facing feature (document summarization) sometimes displays a never-ending loader and misses final credits/usage metadata.

Observed behaviour differs from typical reconnect truncation: there are no duplicate tokens on client rejoin, instead the finalization metadata is absent and worker traces show a successful flush.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use SSE streaming endpoint with a prompt that produces a long multi-paragraph output (token count > 400).
2) Place client behind a corporate edge/proxy that performs HTTP/2 connection multiplexing (observed with vendor X and vendor Y).
3) Initiate stream and force a connection handoff by opening other streams concurrently or by triggering lightweight probes on the same connection to cause stream preemption.

4) Observe client SDK where final '\n\n__end__' style event (our close marker) is never emitted, while server-side worker logs show the final tokens were generated and flushed to the socket before edge GOAWAY/RST.
logs: [edge-proxy] 2026-03-12T15:21:43.520Z WARN connection-reuse preempted-stream stream_id=17 reason=prioritize-probe client_conn=10.0.0.45
customer sdk console: 'SSE: waiting for final event...'
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: Edge multiplexing causes a subtle TCP/TLS handoff where the final server-side flush is acknowledged to the worker process but the proxy swallows the trailing event frame (GOAWAY timing window).

Hypothesis B: Our SSE framing logic relies on a final control frame that can be queued behind higher-priority HTTP/2 frames; when the connection is preempted the control frame is never retransmitted across the new connection path.
We were able to reproduce locally with vendor X's proxy in replayer mode by triggering a GOAWAY immediately after a large flush; reproduce rate ~12% with replayer, ~3% in customer environment.
No evidence of duplicated token replay or corrupted JSON; problem is absence of closing metadata object ("terminal_metadata").
Worker-level traces show write() returned success before edge GOAWAY; kernel-level packet capture shows the final frame transmitted but not delivered to client (dropped by proxy).
comments: 2026-03-12 16:05 - Support (Maya Patel): Confirmed initial report with customer. Requested tcpdump and proxy vendor/version. Asked customer to enable short polling fallback while we investigate.
2026-03-12 18:10 - Customer (KB): Sent pcap and proxy version (EdgeCorp Proxy v3.4.2). Noted behavior improves when they disable HTTP/2 connection pooling.

2026-03-13 09:30 - SRE (Diego Alvarez): Reproduced against EdgeCorp proxy in lab. Created local replayer test that forces GOAWAY after large chunk flush. Raising to in-progress and adding serving-runtime owner.
2026-03-13 14:20 - Eng (Priya Rao): Investigating SSE close semantics; possible mitigation to duplicate terminal metadata in-body so client has fallback in case final control frame is lost.

2026-03-14 10:12 - Support (Maya Patel): Shared recommended customer workaround: disable HTTP/2 connection reuse for streaming clients or enable long-poll fallback in SDK. Customer to test and report.
2026-03-14 13:55 - Customer (KB): Applied workaround (disable reuse) — observed immediate improvement; incidence rate dropped to near zero in initial pass.
resolution:
Workaround applied: instruct customer to disable HTTP/2 connection reuse / enable long-poll fallback in SDK for streaming clients behind multiplexing proxies. Engineering action items:
- short-term: add in-body terminal metadata duplicate (engineer: Priya Rao, PR opened #2433).
- medium-term: update SSE emitter to mark terminal chunk with an idempotent in-stream token so proxies that drop final control frames still carry terminal metadata.
- long-term: add automated test against common edge proxies (EdgeCorp, CorpProxyX) simulating GOAWAY and connection preemption.
Status: customer verified workaround reduces failures; change in serving-runtime PR under review; follow-up INT ticket to add proxy regression tests.
